versions.changelog:
- Initial release of prediction-fair-value-template.
- Scans Simmer markets for price vs. user-defined fair probability and trades if edge exceeds threshold.
- Supports configurable market search query, fair probability, and risk controls via environment variables.
- Default mode is dry-run for safety; live trading must be enabled explicitly.
- Handles market discovery, sizing, context checks, and trade execution out of the box.
- Includes clear instructions for customization and local use.
